notes: A low stone plinth with a gnomon, for the middle of a garden. It is a solid mass, so it stands on its own tile rather than in a doorway.
The shadow it casts is presentation only and follows the shared sky cycle (docs/PEACEFUL_WORLD.md). No crop, garden action or deadline reads it: every gathering instant stays on server time.
The voxel scene draws it through the generic prop branch of src/voxel-world.js furniture(); world.js draws the same silhouette on the pixel map.
